name: Coin Collector
camera_perspective: Fixed orthographic side view, centered on the play area
art_style: Minimal flat solid-color shapes using Unity built-in sprites (Square and Circle) with no textures or external assets
mechanics: Player moves left and right on a flat ground
Collecting a coin increases score by 1
Win condition when all 5 coins are collected
controls: Keyboard: Left/Right arrows or A/D to move, Space or Up arrow to jump
Mobile: On-screen touch buttons for left, right, and jump
level_structure: Single flat green ground plane spanning the width of the camera view. Player starts at the center on the ground. Five yellow coins are placed above the ground at fixed positions, spread horizontally and at varying heights reachable by jumping. No enemies, no obstacles, no additional levels.
ui_requirements: Win message text displaying "YOU WIN!" when all coins are collected
Mobile touch buttons (left, right, jump) visible only on mobile builds

requirements.original_instruction: create Create a very simple 2D mobile game called Coin Collector.
requirements.implementation: Set up a Unity 2D project with a single scene named 'Main'. Configure the project for 2D and mobile (Android/iOS) with landscape orientation. The game title 'Coin Collector' is used as the product name.

requirements.original_instruction: The player is a blue square that moves left and right and jumps on a flat green ground.
requirements.implementation: Create a player GameObject using a Unity built-in Square sprite with solid blue color. Attach a Rigidbody2D and BoxCollider2D. Implement horizontal movement with keyboard input (left/right arrows or A/D) and jump with Space/Up arrow. Create a ground GameObject using a built-in Square sprite with solid green color, scaled to form a flat platform, with BoxCollider2D. Player can move left/right and jump when grounded.

requirements.original_instruction: Place 5 yellow coins above the ground.
requirements.implementation: Create 5 coin GameObjects using Unity built-in Circle sprites with solid yellow color. Position them above the ground at fixed coordinates spread horizontally and at heights reachable by jumping. Each coin has a CircleCollider2D set as a trigger.

requirements.original_instruction: Collecting a coin increases the score by 1 and removes the coin.
requirements.implementation: Implement a coin collection system: when the player's collider overlaps a coin trigger, increment the score by 1, destroy the coin GameObject, and update the score UI text.

requirements.original_instruction: When all 5 coins are collected, display "YOU WIN!".
requirements.implementation: Track the number of collected coins. When the count reaches 5, display a UI Text element with the exact text "YOU WIN!" centered on the screen. The game remains playable but no further actions occur.

requirements.original_instruction: Use only Unity built-in shapes, solid colors, and a simple text UI.
requirements.implementation: Ensure all visual elements use Unity's built-in sprite shapes (Square, Circle) with solid color materials. UI uses Unity's built-in Text (Legacy) or TextMeshPro with simple solid color. No textures, no external assets, no custom art.

requirements.original_instruction: One scene, one level, no enemies, no textures, no external assets, no animations, and no sound.
requirements.implementation: The project contains exactly one scene and one level. No enemy GameObjects, no texture assets, no external asset imports, no animation components/clips, and no audio sources or audio clips. All content is created within the single scene.

requirements.original_instruction: Keep everything minimal, functional, and easy to test.
requirements.implementation: Design the code and scene hierarchy to be simple and modular. Use clear naming and minimal components. Provide a test checklist in the project documentation. Ensure the game can be run and tested quickly in the Unity Editor.

requirements.original_instruction: Use keyboard controls for PC testing and simple touch buttons for mobile.
requirements.implementation: Implement input handling that supports keyboard (arrows/A/D for movement, Space/Up for jump) on PC. For mobile, create on-screen touch buttons (left, right, jump) using Unity UI Buttons that trigger the same movement and jump actions. The touch buttons should be visible only on mobile platforms (e.g., using #if UNITY_ANDROID || UNITY_IOS).

tasks.description: Set up Unity 2D project with single scene 'Main', configure build settings for mobile and PC, set landscape orientation.
Create player GameObject with blue square sprite, Rigidbody2D, BoxCollider2D, and movement/jump script.
Create ground GameObject with green square sprite and BoxCollider2D, scaled to form a flat platform.
Create 5 coin GameObjects with yellow circle sprites and trigger colliders, positioned above ground.
Implement coin collection script: detect trigger overlap, increment score, destroy coin, update UI.
Implement win condition: when collected count reaches 5, display 'YOU WIN!' text.
Create UI Canvas with score text and win text using Unity built-in Text, set solid colors.
Ensure no external assets, textures, animations, audio, or enemies are present in the project; verify scene count and level count.
Create a test checklist and verify all core mechanics work in Editor; ensure minimal and functional design.
Implement keyboard input for movement and jump in the player script.
Create mobile touch buttons (left, right, jump) using Unity UI, wire them to player movement and jump actions, and conditionally enable on mobile platforms.

assumptions: The game is a single-level, single-scene experience with no restart or menu.
The player square is approximately 1x1 units, ground is a thin rectangle spanning the camera width.
Coins are placed at positions reachable by jumping, e.g., at x = -4, -2, 0, 2, 4 and y = 2 or 3.
The camera is orthographic with a size that shows the full play area (e.g., 5 units vertical).
Score starts at 0 and is displayed as 'Score: 0'.
The win text is displayed centered and remains visible after all coins are collected.
Touch buttons are simple UI buttons with text labels 'L', 'R', 'J' or similar.
No physics materials are used; default friction and bounciness.
The game runs at 60 FPS with default gravity.
limitations: No external assets or textures are used; all visuals are Unity built-in shapes.
No animations or sound effects are included.
No enemy AI or additional levels.
The game is minimal and may not have polish beyond the specified requirements.
Mobile touch buttons are simple and may not be optimized for all screen sizes.
The win condition does not stop the player from moving or jumping.
The game does not include a restart mechanism.
